review_candidates.title: Hardware / Electronics Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Day-to-day responsibilities include schematic design, PCB layout, physical prototyping, hands-on testing, and debugging. Key Responsibilities Design circuit schematics, PCB layouts, and power/signal routing based on technical specifications. Troubleshoot thermal, noise, or signal integrity challenges during hardware validation. Qualifications Relevant Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering or a closely related field.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Day-to-day responsibilities include schematic design, PCB layout, physical prototyping, hands-on testing, and debugging. Qualifications Relevant Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering or a closely related field. Hands-on testing and debugging experience using standard lab equipment (oscilloscopes, multimeters, signal generators). Proficiency with standard PCB design software (e.g., KiCad, Altium, EasyEDA) and simulation tools.
